name: Tobias Fox
source:
"I'm not the kind of guy your parents want to meet." 

Frequently competing in gambling TV shows, Tobias is the life of the party, or at least, that’s the image he projects. When not flying off to film in Las Vegas, he likes taking his car out for a spin, practicing magic tricks, and staring into his ever-empty fridge. Even though he’s considered to be sleazy by the general public, he’ll make sure that you don’t view him that way.

Facts: 
• Also goes by “The Fox” and “The Prince of Vegas”
• Afraid of ghosts
• Thinks Alaska is an island

[From the [url=https://www.velvetfoxgames.com/infiniteblue.html]official website[/url]]
